name: Dominion of Blood raises Vampiric Fang's stolen health to 150% (#2212)
contract: Vampiric Fang's tooltip is "Steal ${$m1+0+$SP*0.34} health from an enemy", but none of its eight ranks (804726, 504093-504097, 553271, 553272) carries a leech or heal effect: each is a plain SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE plus an aura 271. The stolen share lives in a separate "Vampiric Fang" record, 572373, SpellFamilyFlags (0, 1073741824, 0), whose one effect is aura type 354 with BasePoints 99 + DieSides 1 = 100 and TriggerSpell 572374, a SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL on the caster with BasePoints 0. AuraEffectHandler[354] is nullptr, no Spell.dbc row applies 572373 and no acquisition route reaches it. Dominion of Blood 680716's tooltip is "Your Vampiric Fang now heals you for an additional 50% of the damage dealt", and its one effect is aura 107 with MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1) and BasePoints 49 + DieSides 1 = +50 over exactly 572373's class mask, so the share reads 100 without the talent and 150 with it. The deterministic discriminator is that modifier on 572373; the end-to-end discriminator is that a Vampiric Fang cast raises the caster's health at all, which it never did before. The caster is dropped to a low value first so the heal is not clipped by the health cap, and health is read while in combat, where out-of-combat regeneration does not run.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The stolen share is the authored 100% before the talent
Leave room for the stolen health
Vampiric Fang steals health back to the caster
Dominion of Blood raises the stolen share to 150%
Dominion of Blood does not touch Bloodbolt
